title: Local stuck steer cannot reach a hung tool; attempt is stopped, not recovered
body:
On a delivered steer, the supervisor breaks out without interrupting the tool tree. A steer is placed after the current tool round, and a hung bash round never ends, so DecideStuck returns StuckStop one StuckAfter later. The old CLI path killed the tool processes and re-prompted, which recovered the worker. steer_test.go:213 asserts the new stop outcome. Consider interrupting the running tool when the evidence is a hung tool.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/supervisor.go:287-297; internal/exec/subprocess/steer_test.go:213
